title: Create accessibility playbook for token refactor and VPAT evidence
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Purpose: Create a lightweight, reproducible accessibility playbook tied to the token refactor initiative and produce VPAT-ready evidence for core components (buttons, compact tables, mini charts, and form controls). Scope intentionally focuses on token-to-UI mappings, keyboard navigation patterns, focus visibility, and contrast relationships that changed as part of the token refactor.

Why now: The token refactor introduced new color ramps and compact density tokens. Early QA found inconsistent focus rings, a handful of color contrast regressions in compact chart overlays, and missing ARIA roles on dense table controls. This ticket organizes audits, prescribes fixes, and collects the artifacts we need for VPAT submission and compliance audits.

Deliverables: a) an "Accessibility Playbook" doc with step-by-step remediation recipes and checklists; b) a prioritized list of component fixes with owners and estimates; c) a VPAT evidence bundle (screenshots, narrative, test cases) for the next compliance review; d) a small regression harness (automated contrast checks + keyboard walkthrough checklist) for CI to prevent re-introductions.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc published in Design Drive with versioned changelog and sign-off by PM and Security
All high and medium contrast findings fixed or mitigated (labels + PRs linked) for buttons, compact tables, and mini charts
Keyboard navigation scenarios documented and validated on supported browsers and VoiceOver/JAWS with at least two reviewers
VPAT evidence bundle uploaded to /Compliance/VPAT_2026_Q1 and PRD includes step-by-step reproduction steps and test artifacts
Regression harness added to design-ci that runs contrast checks for token permutations and warns on failure
steps_taken: 2026-01-15: Kickoff workshop with PM (Lena Ortiz), Eng (Marco Ruiz), and Accessibility SME (Jia Chen); scoped components and agreed on high/med/low priority list
2026-01-22: Ran token diff script against current component snapshots; produced delta report (link below) highlighting 14 suspect contrast pairs
2026-02-02: Quick-fix PRs opened for primary button focus ring and table row focus highlight (github.com/redwood/platform/pull/1438)
2026-02-18: Manual keyboard walkthrough on macOS VoiceOver completed for buttons and compact table; notes captured and added to the playbook
2026-02-25: Design review with security: agreed to preserve token naming for interoperability and to add an accessibility alias file mapping legacy tokens to accessible alternatives
2026-03-03: Initial VPAT evidence folder created and pre-populated with before/after screenshots and narrative (drive link below)
designer_notes: Prioritize visible focus over subtle elevation for compact controls — experiments show users prefer thicker 2px focus ring with 1.5x contrast delta in dense contexts. For charts, avoid background color adjustments that reduce data-ink contrast; instead prefer outline or halo on interactive elements. Keep token aliases small and additive to avoid bloating the palette.
reviewer_feedback: PM Lena Ortiz (2026-02-03): Good prioritization. Please add a customer-facing summary for the release notes explaining the visual changes and why they improve accessibility.
Eng Marco Ruiz (2026-02-07): Will need ENG timeboxed support to add regression checks to design-ci; suggested pairing to scope effort (estimate 2 spikes).

Accessibility SME Jia Chen (2026-02-20): Recommend explicit ARIA roles for table action cells and announceable live regions for chart updates; flagged VoiceOver-specific quirks in compact legend navigation.
